spans.s: तत (I) a. (f. ता) Spread, commenced, (pp. of तन् q.v.), सततगास्ततगानगिरोऽलिभिः Sis.vi.50.
तत (II) n. Any stringed musical instrument.
तत (I) a. (f. ता) Spread, commenced, (pp. of तन् q.v.), सततगास्ततगानगिरोऽलिभिः Sis.vi.50.

तात m. 1. A father, हा तातेति क्रंदितमाकर्ण्य विषण्णः R.ix.75; 2. a term of endearment applied to pupils, younger relatives, or other persons of inferior position, न्यस्यतां कलशस्तात दीयतां कल्कलं मम Ram.; 3. a term of reverence applied to elders and venerable persons, तस्मान्मुच्ये यथा तात संविधातुं तथार्हसि R.i.72, ह्रेपिता हि बहवो नरेश्वरास्तेन तात धनुषा धनुर्भृतः R.xi.40.

ततस् ind. (sometimes used for the abl. forms of तद्) 1. Thence, from that, प्राप्यते ह्यमृतं ततः M.xii.85; 2. there, thither; 3. thereupon, then, afterwards, ततस्ततस्त्या विनियंतुमक्षमा Kir.i.27, ततो नु त्वं प्रेयान् वयमपि हताशाः प्रियतमाः Am.

; 4. in consequence of that, therefore; 5. beyond that, other than that, more than that, ततो दुःखतरं नु किम् Bg.ii.36, vi.22; 6. further, moreover; 7. then (as a correlative of यदि), अमोच्यमश्वं यदि मन्यसे प्रभो ततः समाप्ते विधिनैव कर्माणि &c. R.iii.65.ततस्ततस् 1. ‘here and there,’ e.g. नैशानि सर्वभूतानि प्रचरंति ततस्ततः; 2. ‘what next,’ ‘what further’; (in this sense it often occurs in plays).ततःप्रभृति (correlatire of यतःप्रभृति) ‘from that time forward,’ तृष्णा ततःप्रभृति मे द्विगुणत्वमेति Am.

.ततःकिम् ‘what then,’ ‘what matters it,’ ‘what use is it,’ कल्पं स्थितं तनुभृतां तनुभिस्ततःकिम् Sant.S.iv.2, Bhartr.iii.73, 74.यतः-ततः 1. ‘where-there,’ यतश्च भयमाशंकेत्ततो विस्तारयेद्बलम् M.vii.188; 2. ‘since-then.’यतोयतः-ततस्ततः ‘wher-ever-there,’ यतोयतः षट्चरणोऽभिवर्तते ततस्ततः प्रेरितवामलोचना Sak.i.
ततस्-त्व a. coming from that, proceeding thence, Kir.i.27.
तति (I) pron. (declined only in the plural nom. and acc. तति) So many, e.g. तति पुरुषान् पश्य.
तति (II) f. 1. A series, a row, a line, विस्रब्धं क्रियतां वराहततिभिर्मुस्ताक्षतिः पल्वले Sak.ii.; 2. a number, a troop; 3. a sacrificial act.
ताति (I) m. Offspring.
ताति (II) f. Continuity, train, तदत्रभवता निष्पन्नाशिषां काममरिष्टतातिमाशास्महे Mv.i.

तत्व n. 1. True state, real condition, वयं तत्वान्वेषान्मधुकर हताः Sak.i.; 2. truth, reality; 3. essential nature, संन्यासस्य महाबाहो तत्वमिच्छामि वेदितुम् Bg.xviii.1, M.iv.92; 4. the real nature of the human soul or the world as being identical with the supreme spirit pervading the universe; 5. a first principle; 6. an element, a primary substance; 7. the mind; 8. a kind of dance.

तत्व-अभियोग m. a positive charge or declaration.
तत्व-अभियोग m. a positive charge or declaration.
तत्व-अर्थ m. truth, reality, the real nature.
तत्व-अर्थ m. truth, reality, the real nature.
तत्व-ज्ञ, -विद् a. 1. a philosopher; 2. knowing the true nature of Brahman (n.).

तत्व-तस् ind. truly, accurately, M.vii.10.
तत्व-तस् ind. truly, accurately, M.vii.10.
तत्व-न्यास m. the ceremony of applying mystical letters and marks to the body performed in honour of Viṣṇu.

तत्र ind. (sometimes used for the loc. forms of तद्, Bg.xviii.16, M.ii.112) 1. There, yonder, thither; 2. on that occasion, then, under those circumstances; 3. for that, in that, यस्मदीयाः प्रजास्तत्र हेतुस्त्वद्ब्रह्मवर्चसम् R.i.63.तत्रापि ‘even then, nevertheless’ (a correlative of यद्यपि).तत्रतत्र ‘in various places or cases,’ ‘here and there,’ अध्यक्षान्विविधान्कुर्यात् तत्रतत्र विपश्चितः M.vii.81.
तत्र-त्य a. produced there, belonging to that place.
तत्र-भवत् pron. his honour, his reverence (used of a person not near the speaker) (पूज्ये तत्रभवानत्रभवांश्च भगवानपि), असाधुदर्शी खलु तत्रभवान् काश्यपः य इमामाश्रमधर्मे नियुंक्ते Sak.i.
तत्र-स्थ a. standing there, belonging to that place.
तद्-काल m. the current moment.
तद्-काल˚धी a. having presence of mind.
तद्-कालम् ind. instantly, immediately.
तद्-क्षण m. the current moment, R.i.51.
तद्-क्षणम् ind. instantly, immediately, R.iii.14, Sis.ix.5.
तद्-क्रिय a. working without wages.
तद्-तृतीय a. doing that for the third time.
तद्-पर a. 1. following that, coming after that, inferior; 2. having that as the highest aim, totally devoted to that, eagerly engaged in that, R.i.66, ii.5, Megh.i.10, 19.
तद्-परायण a. solely attached to that.

तद्-पुरुष m. 1. the original or supreme spirit; 2. a class of compounds in which the last member is defined or qualified by the first without losing its original independence, तत्पुरुष कर्मधारय येनाहं स्यां बहुव्रीहिः Ud.
तद्-पूर्व a. 1. happening for the first time, तत्पूर्वभंगो वितथप्रयत्नः R.ii.42; 2. prior, former.
तद्-प्रथम a. doing that for the first time.
तात-गु (I) a. agreeable to a father.
तात-गु (II) m. a paternal uncle.
तातन m. The khanjana bird.
तातल m. 1. A disease; 2. an iron club; 3. cooking or maturing; 4. heat.
तात्कालिक a. (f. की) 1. Simultaneous; 2. immediate.
तात्कालिक a. (f. की) 1. Simultaneous; 2. immediate.

तात्पर्य n. 1. Aim, intended reference to any object, उक्तचतुष्टयविशेषणान्यतरहीनाय न देयेत्युत्कृष्टवरे तात्पर्यात् Rāghavānanda on M.ix.89; 2. meaning, scope, purport; 3. the intention of the speaker in using certain words in a sentence (वक्तुरिच्छा तु तात्पर्यं परिकीर्तितम् Bh.P.).
तात्विक a. (f. की) Real, true, essential, किं चासीदमृतस्य भेदविगमः साचिस्मिते तात्विकः Bh.V.ii.81.
